'''Landing Zone NewsNet''' was a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] news network active in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. The station was represented by [[Journalist/Legends|journalists]] in front of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] [[Senate Building/Legends|Rotunda]] during the [[Plan Delta|Jedi coup of the Galactic Alliance]].
